invite.title: Activate your account

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.subtitle: State of the ITop Med platform.
dashboard.privacyNote: Platform staff see operational data only. Medical records are not accessible from this console.

clinics.title: Clinics
clinics.subtitle: Every clinic is an isolated workspace with its own data, users and settings.
clinics.emptyHint: Create the first clinic workspace to get started.

clinicNew.title: New clinic
clinicNew.subtitle: Creates the isolated workspace, main branch, standard roles, a trial subscription and the owner's account (login and password you set).
clinicNew.name: Clinic name
clinicNew.slugHint: Lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphens. Cannot be changed later.
clinicNew.subtitleNew: The clinic is ready in one click: modules, services and templates for its field, plus the owner's account. The owner signs in and starts working.
clinicNew.sectionTypeHint: Modules, services and templates follow this type. The clinic can change them later.
clinicNew.focusSpecialtyHint: For example cardiology: ECG, echocardiography, Holter and more are added automatically.
clinicNew.ownerIsDoctorHint: The owner gets the doctor role, a profile in the main field and a Mon–Fri 9:00–18:00 schedule.
clinicNew.ownerFrontDesk: The owner also runs the front desk and cash
clinicNew.ownerFrontDeskHint: For small offices: booking patients and taking payments without a receptionist.
clinicNew.ownerHintNew: The owner is the clinic's Admin: staff, settings, money and oversight are theirs.
clinicNew.ownerPasswordHint: A simple password is prepared — write it down or type your own (at least 8 characters). Hand it to the owner in person; it is not shown anywhere later.
clinicNew.networkHint: In a network, that network's admin can manage this clinic.
clinicNew.networkFixed: The clinic is created in your network “{name}”.
clinicNew.createdReadyHow: The owner signs in at this address with the login and the password you set. At the first sign-in the clinic is fully set up for its field:
clinicNew.ownerUsernameHint: The owner signs in with this login (for example admin.shifo).

clinicDetail.modulesHint: Enable or disable product modules for this clinic.
clinicDetail.lifecycleHint: Suspension and archival take effect immediately for all clinic users. Data is never deleted.
clinicDetail.reasonHint: Required. Kept with the clinic record.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Tamper-evident history of security and administrative events.
audit.chainBroken: Integrity check FAILED at event #{seq}. Escalate to security.

staff.title: Platform staff
staff.subtitle: ITop Med employees with access to this console. Every account is personal.
staff.inviteHint: Set their login and first password and hand them over in person.
staff.manageNote: Only a super administrator can add employees.
staff.created: Done: the account was created. They sign in with the login “{username}” and the password you gave.

support.title: Support access
support.hint: Access must be approved by the clinic owner, expires automatically and is fully audited. Clinical-record access is disabled.
support.requested: Request sent. The clinic owner must approve it.

networks.title: Networks
networks.subtitle: A franchise, clinic chain or holding: several clinics with one owner. Each network has its own admin, who creates and runs only that network's clinics.
networks.emptyHint: Create a network for a customer with several clinics.
networks.name: Network name
networks.createHint: Then add clinics and appoint an admin.
networks.detailHint: The network admin creates these clinics, suspends them, switches modules and manages their owners. Plans, platform staff and patients' medical data are not visible to them.
networks.created: Network created. Now add clinics and appoint an admin.
networks.noClinics: No clinics in this network yet.
networks.adminsHint: They sign in to the control panel (/admin) with their own login and password and see only this network.
networks.appointHint: For example the franchise owner or their manager.
networks.clinicRemoved: The clinic was removed from the network.
networks.clinicAdded: The clinic was added to the network.
networks.adminCreated: Network admin created. Hand them the login and password yourself.

clinicBot.title: Telegram bot
clinicBot.hint: The clinic's own bot: patient notifications and the in-Telegram app for patients. Staff sign in with login and password only.
clinicBot.step1: Create a new bot for this clinic in @BotFather and get its token.
clinicBot.step3: Enter the token here. The bot’s menu button (the app inside Telegram) and /start are set up automatically.
clinicBot.tokenHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
clinicBot.saved: The bot is connected and set up.

control.overdueCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing overdue} one {# clinic overdue} other {# clinics overdue}}

control.activityHint: Counts only: who did what and medical data are not shown.
control.staffValue: {d7} in 7 days, {d30} in 30 days, {all} in total

billing.title: Subscriptions & payments
billing.subtitle: Clinics' payments to ITop Med: an invoice is issued every month from the plan; you record the payments.
billing.rulesHint: Invoices are issued on the 1st of every month.
billing.dueDaysHint: Days to pay after the invoice is issued.
billing.suspendAfterDaysHint: Days after the due date before the clinic is suspended. Until then the clinic sees a warning.
billing.autoSuspend: Suspend overdue clinics automatically (you reactivate them)
billing.runHint: The server does this every hour by itself: issues this month's invoices and suspends overdue clinics.
billing.clinicHint: Payments settle the oldest invoices first.
billing.noteHint: For example, the payment order number.
billing.voidConfirm: Yes, void it (the record stays, struck through)

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.setupSettings: Review clinic details and default language
dashboard.setupStaff: Add your staff — one personal account each
dashboard.modulesHint: Sections your clinic uses. The owner switches optional sections on or off in Settings.
dashboard.nobodyWorking: No doctor is scheduled for this day.
dashboard.appointmentsNext: Book patients under Appointments; arrivals and walk-ins are handled in the Queue.
dashboard.setupDoctors: Set up doctors’ profiles and working hours

settings.title: Clinic settings
settings.subtitle: Details shown to your staff and used on documents.
settings.letterheadHint: Printed at the top of documents, receipts and tickets.
settings.logoHint: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 300 KB.
settings.licenseHint: For example: Ministry of Health licence No. …, issued …
settings.locationUrlHint: Your clinic on Google or Yandex Maps (https://…). Printed on forms as a QR code so patients can find you.

branches.title: Branches
branches.subtitle: Locations where your clinic provides care.
branches.name: Branch name

staff.title: Staff
staff.subtitle: Everyone gets a personal account. Shared accounts are not allowed.
staff.rolesHint: Grant only what the person needs for their work.
staff.addHint: Every staff member signs in with their own login and password. Do not share one account between people. If someone forgets their password, set a new one here.
staff.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Write this password down for the person.
staff.created: Done: the account was created. They sign in with the login “{username}” and the password you gave.
staff.usernameHint: The person signs in with this login (for example dr.karimov).

audit.title: Activity log
audit.subtitle: Security and administrative events in your clinic.

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.subtitle: What each role can do in your clinic. Changes apply to everyone with the role on their next action.
roles.name: Role name
roles.locked: The owner role cannot be changed, so the clinic always keeps full administrative access.
roles.clinicalWarning: Clinical permissions give access to patients’ medical information. Grant them only to clinical staff who need them.

member.selfNote: You cannot change your own access. Ask another owner or administrator.
member.ownerNote: Only a clinic owner can change an owner’s access.
member.passwordHint: If the person forgot their password: set a new one and hand it over yourself. All their open sessions are signed out.
member.passwordSet: Password changed. Give the new password to the staff member.

supportAccess.title: Support access
supportAccess.subtitle: ITop Med staff can access your clinic only with your approval, only for a limited time, and every action is recorded.

services.title: Services and prices
services.subtitle: The catalog used for appointments and invoices. Price changes apply to new invoices only.
services.name: Service name
services.emptyHint: Add the consultations, procedures and tests your clinic provides.

services.priceListDone: Done: {created} new services, {updated} prices updated{skipped, plural, =0 {} other {, # lines not understood}}.

facilities.title: Departments and rooms
facilities.subtitle: How your clinic is organised. Rooms are assigned in doctors’ schedules.

doctors.title: Doctors and schedules
doctors.subtitle: Practitioner profiles, weekly working hours and absences. Appointments will be booked into these hours.
doctors.emptyHint: First add staff with the Doctor or Head doctor role.
doctors.slotHint: Default length of one appointment slot.
doctors.bufferHint: Time kept free after each appointment so the queue does not drift. E.g. 15 minutes + 2-minute buffer: 09:00, 09:17, 09:34…
doctors.noSlots: No working hours on this day.
doctors.privacyHint: Absence reasons are categories only. Do not record health information about staff here.
doctors.contactHint: Printed on conclusions for patients' questions.
doctors.commissionHint: The doctor's percentage of money received for their patients; the doctor sees it day by day on “My earnings”. Empty = not set.

mySchedule.title: My schedule
mySchedule.subtitle: Your weekly working hours and upcoming absences.
mySchedule.noProfile: Your practitioner profile has not been set up yet. Ask your clinic administrator.

patients.title: Patients
patients.subtitle: Search by name, phone, MRN, PINFL, passport or birth date (DD.MM.YYYY).
patients.startTyping: Type at least 2 characters to search.
patients.consentsHint: Record only consents the patient actually gave. Care itself does not depend on these.
patients.duplicatesHint: Check whether this person is already registered. Open the existing record if it is the same person.
patients.duplicateBlocking: A patient with the same PINFL or passport already exists. Use the existing record.

patients.reason_similar_name: Similar name, same date of birth
patients.confirmNew: I checked: this is a different person — register anyway

booking.title: Book an appointment
booking.subtitle: Choose the doctor and day, then a free slot. Only working hours are offered.
booking.noSlots: No free slots on this day.
booking.adminNoteHint: Administrative only (e.g. “prefers morning”). Never enter medical details.

queue.title: Today’s appointments and queue
queue.subtitle: Check patients in on arrival. Tickets are numbered per branch and day.
queue.walkInHint: The patient joins the doctor’s queue now without taking a booked slot.
queue.rescheduled: The visit was moved. The patient's reminder follows the new time.

visit.myQueueSubtitle: Checked-in patients first. Start the visit to open the consultation note.
visit.emptyQueue: No patients scheduled for you today.
visit.signHint: After signing, the note cannot be changed — only amended with a reason.

visit.finishHint: Requires a signed note. The appointment is marked completed.
heart: Accentuated second sound over the aorta
visit.copyPreviousHint: Only empty sections are filled from the last signed note.

visit.stageHint: E.g. grade II, NYHA III, G3a
visit.nextVisitHint: The date agreed with the patient is printed on the conclusion.
visit.rxTimesHint: E.g. 08:00, 20:00 — printed as a schedule on the conclusion.

record.title: Medical record

record.noClinicalAccess: Your role does not include access to medical records.
record.fhirHint: Download this record as an HL7 FHIR R4 bundle. The export is recorded in the audit log.
record.excelHint: Download the whole patient record as an Excel file

billing.title: Billing
billing.subtitle: Invoices, payments and refunds. Issued invoices cannot be changed.
billing.toBillEmpty: No visits waiting for an invoice.
billing.issueHint: After issuing, services and amounts are final.

billing.debtHint: The patient pays the rest later: once allowed, the desk can print the final document.

cash.title: Cash desk
cash.subtitle: Open a shift before taking cash. At closing, count the drawer: the difference is recorded.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Revenue, debts and clinic activity for a period. Amounts by currency.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.subtitle: Clinic spending for the financial reports.

lab.title: Laboratory
lab.subtitle: Lab orders by stage. Lab staff see the order and patient identity only, not the medical record.
lab.enterHint: Values are compared with the reference range automatically. You can save partial results.
lab.verifyHint: Verification must be done by a different person than the one who entered the results. Verified results are final.
lab.noAnalytes: This test has no analytes set up yet.

labTests.title: Lab test setup
labTests.subtitle: Analytes, units and reference ranges for each lab test (services of type “Lab test”).

labTests.name: Analyte

labOrder.title: Lab tests
labOrder.noLabTests: No lab tests are set up in this clinic.
labOrder.released: Results are now visible in the patient portal.

nurse.title: Nurse station
nurse.subtitle: Patients in your branch today: vital signs and specimen collection.

portal.title: Patient portal
portal.hint: Patients see their appointments, released lab results and invoices — never doctors’ notes.
portal.none: The patient has no portal access yet. Issue an activation code and hand it over in person.
portal.codeExpired: The activation code has expired. Issue a new one.
portal.disabledInfo: Portal access is turned off. Issuing a new code turns it back on.
portal.locked: Temporarily locked after failed attempts until {date}.
portal.consentHint: How the patient agreed. Recorded in the consent register.
portal.disabled: Portal access turned off; all patient sessions ended.
portal.codeIssued: Activation code: {code}. Give it to the patient in person (not by phone or messenger) with the address {url}. It is shown only once and is valid for 72 hours.

inventory.title: Pharmacy & stock
inventory.subtitle: Medicines and supplies by batch and expiry date. Stock changes only through recorded movements.
inventory.minStockHint: Alert when usable stock in a branch falls below this. 0 = no alert.
inventory.empty: No items yet. Add the medicines and supplies you keep in stock.
inventory.newItemHint: Catalogue entry. Stock is added by receiving batches on the item page.
inventory.name: Name
inventory.issueHint: Taken automatically from the batches that expire first. Expired batches are never used.
inventory.patientMrnHint: Required when dispensing to a patient.
inventory.issued: Done — taken from {batches, plural, one {# batch} other {# batches}}.
inventory.receiveHint: One delivery of one lot. The quantity enters stock through a receipt movement.
inventory.batchesHint: First-expiry-first-out order. Quantities are maintained by the database from the movement log.
inventory.movementsHint: Append-only log of every change, with who and when.

hr.title: HR
hr.subtitle: Staff records, licences and certificates, leave.
hr.profileHint: Only the data the clinic needs to organise work — no home address, passport or health details.
hr.leaveHint: Recorded by type only. Colleagues see an absence, never the reason.
hr.leaveConflicts: Leave recorded. {count, plural, one {# booked appointment falls} other {# booked appointments fall}} in this period — ask the front desk to reschedule.
hr.leaveCancelled: Leave cancelled; the days are bookable again.
hr.doctorLeaveNote: This person is a doctor: recorded leave blocks their bookable days automatically.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: What is connected, what is simulated for testing, and what still needs an agreement with the provider.
integrations.statusHint: Simulated means messages are only written to a local test folder — nothing reaches patients.
integrations.notificationsHint: Sent only on channels the patient has consented to. Messages never contain diagnoses, results or other clinical details.
integrations.logHint: The log holds no message text or addresses. Messages are created when the text is sent.
integrations.checkInDays: Ask this many days after the visit
integrations.checkInDaysHint: 1 to 30. The question goes out that day at 10:00.
integrations.telegramOnlyHint: The check-in question and medicine reminders go through Telegram only. Medicine reminders follow the intake times of the prescription; the message never names the medicine. For a prescription without a duration, reminders run for 30 days. The patient can stop them in the bot.

modules.title: Sections (modules)
modules.hint: Switch off what your practice does not use — it disappears for everyone, including its menu items and permissions.

policy.title: Control rules
policy.hint: Limits for your staff. They do not apply to you as the owner.
policy.ownerOnly: Only the clinic owner can change these rules.
policy.maxDiscountHint: Per invoice line. 100 = no limit, 0 = no discounts.
policy.reasonRequired: A reason is required for every discount
policy.reasonRequiredHint: The reason is shown on the invoice and in the control centre.
policy.onlineHint: Applies to doctors who accept online booking (doctor profile).

rx.title: Prescriptions
rx.hint: Each medicine on its own line. Mistakes are cancelled, never edited.
rx.innHint: Printed in brackets so the pharmacy can dispense the same active substance if this brand is out of stock. e.g. clopidogrel
rx.doseHint: Tablet fractions (1/2, 1/4, 3/4, 1/8) are printed on the prescription as a picture.
rx.allergyCheck: Recorded allergies: {list}. The medicine is checked against them.
rx.allergyConfirm: I am aware of the allergy and still prescribe this medicine.
rx.addedDespiteAllergy: Prescription added despite the recorded allergy (recorded in the audit log).
rx.notElectronic: Paper prescription issued by the clinic; not registered in the national electronic prescription system.
rx.schemesHint: Open a scheme, untick what this patient does not need, and add. Schemes are written on the Templates page.
rx.schemeApplied: The scheme's medicines were added to the prescription.

telegram.title: Telegram bot
telegram.hint: Reminders and confirmations to patients in Telegram, through your clinic's own bot. Patients connect themselves in the patient portal.
telegram.simulated: SIMULATED in this installation: messages are saved as files on the server, not sent to Telegram.
telegram.linkedPatients: {count, plural, one {# patient connected} other {# patients connected}}
telegram.byItopmed: ITop Med connects and sets up the clinic's bot. Contact ITop Med to change it.

desk.title: Front desk
desk.subtitle: Patient, services, payment, measurements and queue number — on one screen.
desk.searchHint: Search by name, phone, record number or birth year. Not found? Enter a new patient below.
desk.confirmNew: This is a new patient (even if a similar one exists)
desk.noPrices: No services with a price yet. Set prices in Services and prices first.

desk.noDoctors: No doctors yet. Create a doctor profile in Doctors and schedule.

desk.duplicateBlocking: A patient with this PINFL or passport already exists — find them with the search.
desk.ticketHint: Please wait until your number is called
desk.chosenCount: {count, plural, =0 {nothing chosen} one {# service} other {# services}}

desk.visitServicesHint: Add a service if needed (echo, ECG …): paid now or left as debt.
desk.debtAmountHint: Leave empty for the whole debt.
desk.followUpFree: Free follow-up until {date} — the visit is free automatically.
desk.freeVisitConfirm: This visit is free although the free follow-up period is over
desk.freeVisitReasonHint: Required. Who allowed it is recorded automatically.
desk.nextNone: Nobody is waiting in the queue right now.

data.title: Where the data is kept
data.whereLocal: This program runs on this computer: all data is kept in the database on this computer.
data.whereServer: This clinic runs on the internet server: data is kept on the server.
data.localHint: No data is sent to the internet or a server. SMS and Telegram messages to patients are off.
data.connectedHintLocal: Data stays on this computer, but SMS and Telegram messages to patients are sent over the internet.
data.connectedHintServer: Data is kept on the server and can be opened from anywhere.

data.filesHint: Each patient's card, visits, prescriptions, vital signs, lab results and payments are written to a separate formatted Excel file that updates itself when something changes, plus a file listing all patients.

data.privacyNote: The files are not encrypted: anyone with access to the folder can read them. Protect the computer with a password.
data.needsHeadDoctor: The files contain medical records, so a staff member with the Head doctor role turns this on.
data.filesLocalOnly: Files in a folder work only in the local (Windows) app. On the server you can download all patients as a ZIP.
data.downloadAllHint: Each patient in a separate file plus a list. The download is recorded in the audit log.
data.filesOff: Patient files turned off. Existing files stay in the folder.

pricing.title: Discounts and packages
pricing.subtitle: Privileged categories, service packages and the free follow-up visit. Discounts are applied to the invoice automatically, with their reason.

pricing.benefitsHint: When a category is set on the patient, its discount applies to all of their services automatically.
pricing.packagesHint: When all services of a package are chosen together, the package discount applies automatically.

deskPrint.title: The document cannot be printed yet

call.called: Number {number} called: shown on the screen and announced.

screens.voice: Voice call (trial: depends on the voices of the browser)

screens.revoked: Screen turned off: the link no longer works.

subscription.overdueBody: Amount due: {amount}. Without payment the clinic will be suspended on {date}. Contact ITop Med about payment.

dispensary.title: Follow-up (dispensary)
dispensary.hint: A patient under long-term follow-up: how often to come, the next check-up date and which tests to repeat. The patient gets a reminder the day before (no diagnosis in it).

dispensary.firstDueHint: Empty — that many days from today.
dispensary.enrolled: The patient is now under follow-up.
dispensary.listHint: Your long-term patients, nearest due date first. Overdue ones are red.

earnings.title: My earnings
earnings.subtitle: Money received for your patients (less refunds) and your share at the clinic's rate.
earnings.noPercent: Your percentage is not set yet. The clinic's manager sets it on the Doctors page.

connect.title: Connect this device

trust.android: Settings → Security → Encryption & credentials → Install a certificate → CA certificate → choose the downloaded file.
trust.ios: Settings → “Profile Downloaded” → Install. Then Settings → General → About → Certificate Trust Settings → turn on “ITop Med Local CA”.
trust.desktop: Windows: open the file → Install Certificate → Current User → “Trusted Root Certification Authorities” → Finish. macOS: open the file → Keychain → “Always Trust”. Then restart the browser.

install.android: Chrome menu (⋮) → “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
install.ios: In Safari: Share → “Add to Home Screen”.
install.desktop: The install icon in the address bar, or the browser menu → “Install app”.

connect.fingerprint: Certificate fingerprint (SHA-256) — compare it with the one shown on the device:
connect.why: The certificate is only for the ITop Med server on this clinic's network and is installed once per device. After that, data travels encrypted.
connect.typeHint: Open this address in the browser of the phone or tablet. The device must be on the same Wi-Fi network as this computer.
